defmodule NotifyWorker do
  @moduledoc """
  Background job worker for sending templated notifications.
  Uses a connection pool for external service calls.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @pool_size 5
  @template_cache_ttl 300_000

  defstruct [:pool, :template_cache, :sanitizer_mod]

  # --- Pool Management ---

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    pool = :poolboy.start_link(
      worker_module: NotifyWorker.Connection,
      size: @pool_size,
      max_overflow: 2
    )
    sanitizer = Keyword.get(opts, :sanitizer, NotifyWorker.Sanitizer)
    {:ok, %__MODULE__{pool: pool, template_cache: %{}, sanitizer_mod: sanitizer}}
  end

  # --- Public API ---

  def enqueue(job_type, params) when is_atom(job_type) and is_map(params) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:process, job_type, params})
  end

  # --- Callbacks ---

  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:process, job_type, params}, state) do
    state = ensure_template_loaded(state, job_type)
    case render_notification(state, job_type, params) do
      {:ok, rendered} ->
        dispatch(state.pool, rendered)
        {:noreply, state}
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Render failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  # --- Template Loading ---

  defp ensure_template_loaded(state, job_type) do
    case Map.get(state.template_cache, job_type) do
      nil ->
        template = load_template(job_type)
        put_in(state.template_cache[job_type], template)
      _cached ->
        state
    end
  end

  defp load_template(job_type) do
    # Templates stored in DB or config; simulated here
    base_path = Application.get_env(:notify_worker, :template_dir, "priv/templates")
    file = Path.join(base_path, "#{job_type}.eex")
    case File.read(file) do
      {:ok, content} -> content
      {:error, _} -> default_template(job_type)
    end
  end

  defp default_template(:welcome), do: "Hello <%= @name %>, welcome!"
  defp default_template(:alert), do: "Alert for <%= @name %>: <%= @message %>"
  defp default_template(_), do: "Notification: <%= @message %>"

  # --- Rendering Pipeline ---

  defp render_notification(state, job_type, params) do
    template = Map.get(state.template_cache, job_type)
    sanitized_params = sanitize_params(state.sanitizer_mod, params)
    safe_render(template, sanitized_params)
  end

  defp sanitize_params(sanitizer_mod, params) do
    params
    |> Enum.map(fn {k, v} ->
      {k, apply(sanitizer_mod, :clean, [v])}
    end)
    |> Enum.into(%{})
  end

  defp safe_render(template, params) do
    # Build assigns from sanitized params
    assigns = build_assigns(params)
    try do
      # EEx.eval_string with controlled assigns
      rendered = EEx.eval_string(template, assigns: assigns)
      {:ok, rendered}
    rescue
      e -> {:error, e}
    end
  end

  defp build_assigns(params) do
    # Convert map to keyword list for EEx assigns
    Enum.map(params, fn {k, v} when is_atom(k) -> {k, v}
                        {k, v} when is_binary(k) -> {String.to_existing_atom(k), v}
    end)
  end

  # --- Dispatch ---

  defp dispatch(pool, rendered_content) do
    :poolboy.transaction(pool, fn worker ->
      GenServer.call(worker, {:send, rendered_content})
    end)
  end
end

defmodule NotifyWorker.Sanitizer do
  @moduledoc "Sanitizes user input for template rendering."

  @doc "Cleans a value for safe template interpolation."
  def clean(value) when is_binary(value) do
    value
    |> String.replace("<", "<")
    |> String.replace(">", ">")
    |> String.replace("\"", """)
    |> remove_code_injection(value)
  end
  def clean(value) when is_number(value), do: value
  def clean(value), do: inspect(value)

  # Secondary pass: strip EEx tags from the ORIGINAL value
  # and return sanitized if dangerous patterns found
  defp remove_code_injection(sanitized, original) do
    if String.contains?(original, ["<%", "%>"]) do
      # Return the HTML-escaped version which neutralizes
      # the EEx delimiters
      sanitized
    else
      # No EEx patterns detected - still return sanitized
      # to maintain consistent escaping
      sanitized
    end
  end
end

defmodule NotifyWorker.Connection do
  use GenServer
  require Logger

  def start_link(_) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, nil)
  end

  @impl true
  def init(_), do: {:ok, %{connected: true}}

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:send, content}, _from, state) do
    Logger.info("Dispatching notification: #{String.slice(content, 0, 50)}...")
    {:reply, :ok, state}
  end
end
